body.heading: Start the chain
paragraphs: One person says a simple word, like cat. The next person says a word that rhymes, like hat or bat.
Keep going around the circle. Each person adds one more rhyming word.

body.heading: When the chain breaks
paragraphs: If nobody can think of a rhyme, clap together and start again with a new word. There is no losing in this game.
Try starters like moon, cake, or tree, and see which chain grows the longest.

takeaway: Rhyming words sound alike at the end, and you can play with them anywhere.
safetyNotes: Sit in a circle so everyone can hear each other.
screenFreeExtension: Keep the chain going on a walk and rhyme with the things you pass.
